title: Complete clock countdown pass
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $cfg$ be a four-tape configuration over $x$, let $bs$ be a finite Boolean clock word, let $bits$ assign a Boolean to each index below $8$, and let $halt$ be a Boolean flag. Assume the control of $cfg$ is the pending-action state carrying $bits$ and $halt$. Starting from the six-tape lift of $cfg$ with clock word $bs$, after exactly $2|bs|+2$ steps the timed interpreter reaches the clock-phase configuration with control $(borrow(bits,halt,c))$, clock word $bs'$, and head at $|bs|$, where $(c,bs')$ is the fixed-width subtraction of an incoming borrow from $bs$.
hypotheses_covered: A four-tape configuration over $x$ whose control is the specified pending-action state
A Boolean action-bit function indexed below 8
replaced:
From the six-tape lift of a pending-action configuration with clock word $w$,
exactly $2|w| + 2$ steps of the timed interpreter complete the clock rewind
and the borrow pass, reaching the borrow phase at the right blank with the
subtracted word and its underflow flag in the control.
